# Has Status ability detections

Source: [Abilities Detected by "Has Status"](../archive/2698.md); page edited 2024-08-31.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/2698.md#wiki-2698) before using these values.

Source edited 2024-08-31; verification code YFPB7.

Spawn areas count as Phased Out. Accretion/Earthshatter can set both Knocked Down and Stunned. Artillery/Rip-Tire are not Rooted merely because movement is immobilized.
